qualification: Contact projection can reinforce downhill gravity, but this does not partition motor action, passive rolling or impacts. Belt pressure occupancy is measured during the prior held command, not at the later observer sample.
scope: Explicit posthoc pulse/held-command supplement; no original definition/gate changes or new physics.
